decisions.decision: Committee agreed to leave the job title as Beach Director, after public comment from Ana Lockwood.
decisions.quote: j. bilotta agreed and said that the committee agrees to leave it as beach director.

decisions.decision: Committee discussed the COA Director's input on the COA Outreach Coordinator grade and did not add a second grade change at this time.
decisions.quote: the committee discussed the input but did not feel a second grade change was warranted at this time.

decisions.decision: J. Belliveau will prepare the Committee's recommendations into a formal package for the Town Manager, who will pass it to the Select Board and Finance Committee; members will be available for questions.
decisions.quote: julie will prepare the recommendations into a formal package to deliver to the town manager, who will then provide it to the select board and finance committee.
